scope: Transient admission owner with retained original metadata and tenant-only descriptor views. Default Rust allocator; no production persistence, query certification, browser delivery or provider calls. Call counters exclude diagnostic writes and reply encoding. Memory is allocated Wasm pages, not retained payload size.
bound: Per-object header entry/framed-byte limits multiplied by catalog lifetime object slots bound retained metadata, globally and per tenant. String/vector and allocator overhead are additional. Exact retries keep the first copy; cancellation and settlement do not recycle lifetime slots. This is not a total-memory-fit proof for arbitrary configurations.

maximum_metadata.scope: Four prepared then cancelled objects across two tenants, each with eight headers and 1024 framed metadata bytes. Reordered retries, overflow rejection, full lifetime history, suspension and stop/start. Transient probe; no production persistence, certified descriptor or provider calls. Counters exclude reply encoding/diagnostics.

multi_file.comparison: Sequential implementation snapshots, not an isolated attribution of instruction changes to metadata. Counters include IC memory-region charges; default allocator locality changes between builds.

reproduction: make test-admission-resources emits .tmp/descriptor-resources.json and .tmp/release-history.json alongside the other workload reports. The complete admission test target additionally covers actual descriptor caller isolation and client verification.
